import numpy as np, collections, scipy.ndimage as ndi
def maximal_rectangles(A):
    # all maximal all-zero rects: not contained in larger zero rect
    H,W=A.shape
    res=[]
    for r0 in range(H):
        for c0 in range(W):
            if A[r0,c0]!=0: continue
            # extend right & down greedily: width limited by column runs
            maxw=W-c0
            for r1 in range(r0,H):
                cur=(A[r1,c0:c0+maxw]==0).all() if c0+maxw<=W else False
                # shrink width while invalid
                while maxw>1 and not cur:
                    maxw-=1
                    cur=(A[r1,c0:c0+maxw]==0).all()
                # now rect r0..r1, c0..c0+maxw-1, check height extension: must not extend further down with same width
                canextenddown = (r1+1<H and (A[r1+1,c0:c0+maxw]==0).all())
                if canextenddown: continue
                # also must not extend right with same height
                canextendright = (c0+maxw<W and (A[r0:r1+1,c0+maxw:c0+maxw+1]==0).all())
                if canextendright: continue
                res.append((r0,r1,c0,c0+maxw-1))
    return res
def solve(A):

                if (r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1)) and A[r,c]==0:
                    out[r,c]=inst
    return out.tolist()

import numpy as np, collections, scipy.ndimage as ndi
def f(A):
    A=np.array(A)
    cnt=collections.Counter(A[A!=0].tolist())
    inst=min(cnt,key=lambda k:cnt[k])
    lab,n=ndi.label(A==0,structure=np.ones((3,3)))
    out=A.copy()
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        pts={(int(r),int(c)) for r,c in zip(*np.where(lab==i))}
        y0=min(p[0] for p in pts); y1=max(p[0] for p in pts); x0=min(p[1] for p in pts); x1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
        if len(pts)<2 or y1-y0<1 or x1-x0<1: continue
        ring=set((y0,x) for x in range(x0,x1+1))|set((y1,x) for x in range(x0,x1+1))|set((r,x0) for r in range(y0,y1+1))|set((r,x1) for r in range(y0,y1+1))
        # count comp's own cells that lie on ring vs interior zeros
        if len(pts)>1 and (ring-pts)=={}:  # solid rect with missing side -> paint full ring
            for r,c in ring: out[r,c]=inst
        elif len(pts)>len(pts&ring) and len(pts)-len(pts&ring)<=4:  # frame with gaps: paint ALL ring
            for r,c in ring: out[r,c]=inst
    return out.tolist()
